timeline_disposition.reason: Gersonides (Levi ben Gerson, 1288–1344) is a securely historical Jewish philosopher, mathematician and astronomer, but SEP explicitly describes his biography as sketchy. It places him in Provence, probably Orange, with trips to Avignon. Given the sparse person-specific chronology and changing medieval jurisdictional context, ATLAS does not force a single canonical polity-bound Activity rail.

sources.title: Gersonides — Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy
sources.citation_text: SEP identifies Gersonides (Levi ben Gerson, 1288–1344) as a major medieval Jewish thinker; his biography is sparse, with residence chiefly in Orange in Provence and several trips to Avignon.
